title: Vikings Stand Behind J.J. McCarthy Despite Early-Career Struggles

title: Kevin O'Leary Says 'I Don't Care If It's A Gift For Your Birthday'—Take 10% Of Any Money That Comes Your Way And Invest It To Get Rich
summary: Kevin O'Leary isn't interested in your excuses—especially the ones wrapped in a bow. In a 2020 interview with CNBC, the "Shark Tank" investor didn't just suggest setting money aside.
